townyScope: Administrator-only overview. Open join and public spawn are Towny flags, not website access permissions. Claims are provider townblocks, not a map area. Changes are made in game.
townyTownless: Towny knows this resident, who currently has no town.
townyCounts: {towns, plural, one {# town} other {# towns}} / {nations, plural, one {# nation} other {# nations}}
townyTruncated: Showing {towns, plural, one {# town} other {# towns}} and {nations, plural, one {# nation} other {# nations}} in UUID order; additional entries are omitted.
townyUnavailable: Towny is installed but its observations are unavailable. Check the provider on the game server.
planScope: Stored Plan sessions on this server, including AFK time. An unsaved current session is not included. First and last seen refer to stored sessions, not live presence.
planUnavailable: Plan is installed but its statistics are unavailable. Check the game server's Plan database and Query API.
chunkyIntro: Chunky reports loaded worlds and saved tasks every 20 seconds. This view refreshes automatically. Paused tasks survive server restarts; generation does not enable server maintenance or stop player connections.
chunkyState_stopped: Stopped (saved checkpoint cannot distinguish completion from cancellation)
chunkyCancelWarning: Cancel this world's generation and discard its resume point? Generated chunks remain in the world.
chunkyQueued: Generation operation queued. Watch the task result and world state for confirmation.
chunkyTask_dispatched: Dispatched, awaiting result. If interrupted, inspect world state before submitting again; this operation will not replay automatically.
openMap: Open map in a new tab
mapUrl: Browser map URL (saved camera links allowed)
mapOriginMissing: This map origin has not been enabled for embedding. Open it in a new tab, or configure ISLES_MAP_ORIGINS when building the Web service.
portalIntro: Our worlds, players and shared adventures. Prepare your client and meet us in game.
portalPlayerHint: Link your in-game identity to see your groups and places. Keep your skin and launcher credentials with your account.
portalLocalContent: Mods and modpacks from this community
protocolHint: Reported by ViaVersion after configured blocks. The proxy, authentication mode and required mods still need to match.
regionsTruncated: Only the first 32 matching regions are shown.
catalogIntro: Search optional upstream catalogs and choose a version for your server or client. Downloads remain with their original publisher.
catalogNoResults: No matching projects. Try another name or platform.
catalogNoVersions: No versions match the selected filters in this page of upstream results.
catalogNoFiles: This release has no direct download for the selected platform. Visit the original project.
catalogDeclarations: Compatibility and hashes below are declared by the upstream publisher. A download is not installed or verified by this page.
bridgeIntro: Install the Paper bridge to verify game identities, read optional plugin data, and apply membership changes.
rotateWarning: Existing Bridge credentials will stop working. Update the plugin configuration with the new token.
tokenOnce: Copy this token into the server plugin configuration. It is shown only now.
pairIntro: Generate a one-time code, then run the command inside the server to prove control of your game identity.
signInRequired: Sign in with your website account to link a game identity.
bridgeStale: Bridge observation is unavailable or expired
title: Servers
intro: Find your world, prepare your client, and join.
empty: No servers have been published yet.
adminIntro: Connect existing tools, bind a game instance, and publish its player-facing information.
credentials: Mirror rescue token (optional when signed in as an administrator)
name: Name
tokenHint: Leave blank to preserve the existing token. Tokens are not returned by the service.
label: Link label
accepted: Operation accepted. Refresh process status to confirm.
setup: Set ISLES_URL and ISLES_ADMIN_TOKEN on the Web server to enable this integration.
mapHint: Maps and statistics open in their own tools. Member-only services keep their own access controls.
